doc_errors.where: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md — 'Controls and Features' table (line 362) and 'Controls that need element-level swaps' (line 569)
doc_errors.wrong: Presents MediaElement -> MediaPlayerElement as a namespace/element swap where 'Source and transport-control properties carry over with minor renames'.
doc_errors.correct: MediaPlayerElement has NO Play/Pause/Stop/SetSource/AudioCategory/AutoPlay/CurrentState members. Playback moves to a Windows.Media.Playback.MediaPlayer set via element.SetMediaPlayer(new MediaPlayer()); drive via element.MediaPlayer.Play()/Pause(); Stop() = Pause()+PlaybackSession.Position=TimeSpan.Zero; source via MediaPlayer.Source = MediaSource.CreateFromStream/Uri(...); AudioCategory enum type changes from Windows.UI.Xaml.Media.AudioCategory to Windows.Media.Playback.MediaPlayerAudioCategory; MediaElementState -> MediaPlaybackState on PlaybackSession.

special_apis.special_handling: Re-architect to MediaPlayerElement + MediaPlayer (SetMediaPlayer); element-level Play/Pause/Stop/SetSource/AudioCategory move onto the MediaPlayer instance.
No per-view singleton on desktop; obtain SMTC from the MediaPlayer instance: mediaPlayer.SystemMediaTransportControls.
Windows.UI.Xaml.Media.AudioCategory -> Windows.Media.Playback.MediaPlayerAudioCategory (member names carry over: Movie, Media, GameChat, ...).
No MediaPlayerElement/MediaPlayer property equivalent; rely on AudioCategory or set MediaPlayer.AudioDevice. In this sample the setter was unused so it was safely dropped.
